mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.workflow_id, t.tenant_id, t.name, t.version, t.status, t.updated_at, t.description, t.author, t.config_schema, t.required_permissions, t.tools, t.connector_requirements FROM nw_workflow_templates t WHERE t.workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND (t.status = 'review' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nw_workflow_review_decisions d WHERE d.template_id = t.id)) FOR SHARE OF t

SELECT t.workflow_id AS id, t.name AS workflow_name, t.author, CASE WHEN t.status = 'review' THEN 'pending' ELSE d.decision END AS status, t.version, CASE WHEN t.status = 'review' THEN t.updated_at ELSE d.source_updated_at END AS revision_at, t.updated_at, CASE WHEN t.status != 'review' THEN d.reason END AS reason, CASE WHEN t.status != 'review' THEN d.actor_id END AS reviewer_id, CASE WHEN t.status != 'review' THEN d.created_at END AS reviewed_at FROM nw_workflow_templates t LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT decision, reason, actor_id, created_at, source_updated_at FROM nw_workflow_review_decisions WHERE template_id = t.id ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) d ON true WHERE (t.status = 'review' OR d.decision IS NOT NULL)
AND CASE WHEN t.status = 'review' THEN 'pending' ELSE d.decision END = #{status}
AND (strpos(lower(t.name), lower(#{search})) > 0 OR strpos(lower(t.workflow_id), lower(#{search})) > 0)
ORDER BY COALESCE(d.created_at, t.updated_at) DESC, t.id DESC
SELECT id, workflow_id, tenant_id, version, status, updated_at FROM nw_workflow_templates WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_workflow_templates SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{at}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'published' THEN #{at} ELSE published_at END WHERE id = #{templateId} AND status = 'review'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_workflow_review_decisions(id, template_id, tenant_id, version, source_updated_at, decision, reason, actor_id, created_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{template.id}, #{template.tenantId}, #{template.version}, #{template.updatedAt}, #{decision}, #{reason}, #{actorId}, #{at})
